summary: Iteration 3 (Projects redesign) verified end-to-end against public preview. Backend pytest 9/9 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_projects_api.py: list sorted by deadline asc with client_name attached, POST creates project + auto-linked canvas honoring mannequin_gender ('male' persisted), GET bundle returns project+client+pdfs+canvas, PUT flips status ongoing→completed and is persisted on subsequent GET, POST /api/projects/{id}/pdfs upload + 200 + size_bytes>0 + appears in bundle, PUT/GET /api/projects/{id}/canvas round-trips strokes (d,color,width) and gender, GET /api/clients/{id}/projects returns the project list sorted, plus 404 paths (unknown project, unknown client on create). Frontend (390x844 web preview): bottom tab is labeled 'Projects' with no 'Clients' tab visible, Projects list renders the seeded 'Bridal lehenga' card with client name (ANAÏS MEHTA), location, deadline (Aug 15 2026), progress bar (₹50,000 of ₹150,000 · ₹100,000 pending), and ongoing pill. FAB opens the create modal; picking a client via pick-client → client-option-* + filling field-title/location/deadline/description/total/paid + form-gender-male + tapping save-project routes to /project/{id}. Project detail shows client-link, project-title, Created+Deadline date columns, payment bar with Paid/Remaining amounts, edit-payment button, and toggle-status (flipped ongoing→completed live). open-canvas reveals MannequinCanvas with gender-female/gender-male toggles, canvas-surface, color/width palette, canvas-undo/canvas-clear/canvas-save — mouse-drag drew a stroke and canvas-save fired PUT /api/projects/{id}/canvas → 200. Tapping client-link routes to /client/{id}; client profile shows the stats row (1 PROJECTS / 0 ONGOING / 1 COMPLETED reflecting the live status flip) and the project as a tappable client-project-{id} row.

issues: On the web preview the Modal's inner ScrollView does not auto-scroll a tap target into view when the Picker dropdown is opened with many clients — long lists may push save-project / form-gender-* below the fold. Real touch scrolling works; consider giving the picker dropdown its own bounded scroll (it already has maxHeight:200 but on narrow viewports the parent still ends up overflow-clipped). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/projects.tsx:159-225

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '[Layout children]: Too many screens defined. Route "clients" is extraneous.' — _layout.tsx still declares <Tabs.Screen name="clients" href={null} /> but the file route was removed. Either delete the entry or remove the orphan route file. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:43-46
Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (RN web). Originates from third-party UI lib or react-native-web defaults. Low priority. Reference: bundled output

action_items: Remove the orphan <Tabs.Screen name="clients" href={null} /> entry in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (or delete the /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/clients.tsx file if it still exists) to silence the 'Too many screens defined' warning.

Optional UX polish: in projects.tsx, when the pick-client dropdown is open, scroll the modal's ScrollView so the dropdown's first option is in view (or render the picker as a separate Modal). This only affects web with many clients.
Optional: previous iteration_2 nit (calendar day cell 48px width) remains; unrelated to this redesign.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:553-567 — list_projects fetches all projects then sorts in Python (deadline-or-9999, created_at) AFTER the Mongo .sort("deadline", 1). The Mongo sort is effectively no-op because the Python re-sort is the source of truth. Consider dropping the Mongo sort or building a proper aggregation. Functionally correct.

server.py:599-611 — get_project returns canvas under a default shape when missing, but it does not insert a backup canvas (unlike GET /canvas at line 654-660 which upserts). Minor inconsistency — currently every create_project also creates a canvas, so the fallback is rarely hit.
server.py:556-566 — Sorting key uses created_at as the tie-breaker; missing 'created_at' yields '' which sorts before real timestamps. OK in practice since all docs have created_at.

project/[id].tsx:58 — uses FileSystem.readAsStringAsync from expo-file-system/legacy. The non-legacy import would be cleaner; legacy path works but should be migrated when the file-system 17+ API is adopted.
MannequinCanvas — not deeply reviewed in this iteration; PUT canvas round-trips strokes [{d,color,width}] correctly as verified by E2E.
frontend/.env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/src/api.ts:1) but the system documents EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Both are present in the repo's .env so it works; just a naming nit.
